# Skylos Documentation

> Skylos is an open-source (Apache-2.0), local-first static analysis CLI and pull-request gate. It finds dead code, security issues, secrets, vulnerable dependencies, quality regressions and AI-code mistakes. The CLI runs without an account.

Available as a CLI, GitHub Action, MCP server and VS Code extension.

## Key facts

- Install: `pip install skylos` (Python 3.10+), then `skylos .` for dead code or `skylos . -a` for every analyzer. Container: `ghcr.io/duriantaco/skylos`.
- Languages: dead code in 10 languages and security checks in 9, deepest in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript and Java. Go dead-code and security checks need the `skylos-go` engine, which the PyPI package does not include; the Docker image and GitHub Action do.
- AI coding agents: `skylos done --base main` flags deleted or skipped tests, loosened CI test steps, silenced lint or type checks, and test-only special cases. It runs pytest itself; other runners need a `test_command`. `skylos agent install-hooks` checks Claude Code, Codex and Cursor edits locally.
- CI: `skylos cicd init` writes a GitHub Actions pull-request gate; add `--no-upload` without Skylos Cloud.
- MCP: `skylos mcp`. Without `SKYLOS_API_KEY`, only `analyze` works: five free calls per rolling 24 hours. Every other tool needs a free Skylos API key. MCP scans run locally and use no Skylos credits, but authenticated calls contact Cloud to authorize the tool. MCP remediation costs 10 credits; LLM-provider charges are separate. Enterprise has unlimited credits. Local CLI scans need no account and use no credits.
- Pricing: the CLI is free. Skylos Cloud has a Free plan; one-time credit packs start at $9 for 50 credits.

## Getting Started

- [Installation](https://docs.skylos.dev/installation): Install via pip, system requirements, Python 3.10+
- [Quick Start](https://docs.skylos.dev/quick-start): Step-by-step workflow guide
- [Configuration](https://docs.skylos.dev/configuration): Configure via pyproject.toml — exclusions, thresholds, quality gates
- [CLI Reference](https://docs.skylos.dev/cli-reference): All command-line flags and options

## Command Chooser

- `skylos PATH`: scan source; dead code by default, every main source analyzer with `-a`.
- `skylos verify [PATH]`: scan the selected source for AI-code mistakes; a separate Python behavior result compares supported working changes with Git HEAD.
- `skylos done --base main`: run the branch's tests and check for existing tests deleted, newly skipped or left without countable assertions, loosened test settings, edited Skylos settings and added secrets. Fewer assertions and silenced checks advise by default; writes a receipt.
- `skylos agent install-hooks [--codex|--cursor]`: check each coding-agent edit locally and hold "done" while new issues are open.
- `skylos cicd init`: write a GitHub Actions pull-request gate (add `--no-upload` without Skylos Cloud).
- `skylos preflight [ARTIFACT]`: statically check an exact local GPU artifact against `.skylos/gpu-targets.yml`; OCI input is identity-only and returns `UNKNOWN` in the CLI.
- `skylos image scan IMAGE@sha256:<digest> --platform os/arch`: ask separately installed Trivy to scan a remote registry image; findings gate only with `--fail-on`.
- `skylos suite [DIRECTORY]`: build one static, debt, defense, and provenance report; findings are report-only by default.
- `skylos defend [DIRECTORY]`: report guardrails for recognized Python and TypeScript/JavaScript LLM integrations; threshold flags or policy enable gating.
- `skylos clean [PATH] --dry-run`: preview Python import/function cleanup without writing.

## Coding Agents

- [Verify an AI Coding Agent's Branch](https://docs.skylos.dev/done-gate): `skylos done` checks that a change is finished, with exit codes, settings, CI setup and limits
- [Agent-Loop Hooks](https://docs.skylos.dev/agent-hooks): `skylos agent install-hooks` for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
- [Your First Gated PR](https://docs.skylos.dev/first-gated-pr): set up the Skylos Quality Gate and Skylos Done checks on GitHub

## Core Features

- [Dead Code Detection](https://docs.skylos.dev/dead-code-detection): Find unused functions, imports, classes, and variables
- [Security Analysis](https://docs.skylos.dev/security-analysis): SAST with taint analysis for SQL injection, SSRF, XSS, command injection, path traversal, and unsigned webhook handlers
- [GitHub Actions Security](https://docs.skylos.dev/github-actions-security): CI/CD workflow scanner for dangerous triggers, broad permissions, unpinned actions, unsafe secrets, OIDC release risk, and mutable containers
- [Code Quality](https://docs.skylos.dev/code-quality): Complexity, nesting depth, mutable defaults, standards-backed practice rules, and advisory quality rollout
- [Technical Debt](https://docs.skylos.dev/technical-debt): Structural debt hotspots, baseline comparison, changed-scope reviews, and saved debt history reports
- [Framework Awareness](https://docs.skylos.dev/framework-awareness): Django, Flask, FastAPI, Pydantic, and pytest recognition to reduce false positives
- [Smart Tracing](https://docs.skylos.dev/smart-tracing): Runtime call tracing for dynamic code
- [Release Reliability](https://docs.skylos.dev/release-reliability): GPU source/build contracts and exact local artifact preflight with PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN evidence

## Integrations

- [CI/CD Integration](https://docs.skylos.dev/ci-cd): GitHub Actions, advisory quality checks, GitLab CI, Jenkins setup with quality gates
- [GitHub Actions Security](https://docs.skylos.dev/github-actions-security): Workflow hardening and PR-time CI/CD supply-chain checks
- [VS Code Extension](https://docs.skylos.dev/vscode): Real-time analysis in the editor
- [MCP Server](https://docs.skylos.dev/mcp-server): Connect to Claude Desktop, Cursor, and AI assistants via Model Context Protocol; every tool except `analyze` needs a Skylos Cloud API key
- [Claude Code Security](https://docs.skylos.dev/integrations/claude-code-security): Security ingestion for Claude Code

## Concepts

- [Taint Analysis](https://docs.skylos.dev/concepts/taint-analysis): How Skylos traces untrusted data through code
- [Pattern Detection](https://docs.skylos.dev/concepts/pattern-detection): Rule-based detection patterns
- [Vibe Coding Detection](https://docs.skylos.dev/concepts/vibe-coding): Detecting AI-generated code risks

- [Rules Reference](https://docs.skylos.dev/rules-reference): All detection rules with IDs and severity
- [Case Studies](https://docs.skylos.dev/case-studies): Merged cleanup PRs with all outcomes, and the done-gate benchmark
- [FAQ](https://docs.skylos.dev/faq): Common questions and troubleshooting
